addressRegion.description: County / Province / State. Not required for most countries and often omitted to make the checkout form shorter.

denied.description: Determines if the customer can log in. Defaults to 0

email.description: The email address is the unique identifier for the customer.

houseNo.description: House number. Some places have no house numbers.

knowsLanguage.description: Language in ISO 639-1. Choose from: cs, da, de, el, en, es, fi, fr, it, ja, ko, nl, no, pl, pt, ro, ru, sv, tr, zh (traditional Chinese).

postalCode.description: Zip code. Not all countries have zip codes.
